description: Frozen Benchmark Specifications for Multibagger Live Decision Quality Evaluation

benchmarks.name: Universe Equal-Weight Passive Hold
benchmarks.description: Allocates equal capital (₹5 Lakhs) across all 20 universe stocks on their first available trading session and holds passively with zero rebalancing or exits.

benchmarks.name: Simple Systematic Fundamental Filter (No AI)
benchmarks.description: Systematic mechanical rule: Invests equal weight in universe stocks satisfying revenue_growth_yoy_pct >= 15.0% AND ebitda_margin_pct >= 15.0% AND trailing_pe <= 50.0. Exits to cash if ebitda_margin < 10.0% or revenue_growth < 0%.

benchmarks.name: Quarterly Rebalanced Equal-Weight Universe
benchmarks.description: Equal-weights all active universe stocks at the start of each calendar quarter, resetting portfolio weights back to 5.0% per stock.
